structured P0002/P0003/P0004 family truth and current-context repair
global and nested proof-status agreement gates
generic frozen artifact inventory support and wrapper-bound head truth without mutating creation-time bytes

verified_contracts: malformed descriptor rejected before blob I/O

non_claim: P0004-D002 is an internal anthology-candidate hold only. Its delayed review, OCI conformance, path-containment tests, candidate packet, and reader edition are not external reader evidence, admission, publication clearance, or proof of literary quality. The exact rev0068 draft retains its creation-time same-turn disclosure as history; current status comes only from the rev0069 review and candidate wrapper. P0002-D010 still has no real response.
